theme.description: Black dominant background with warm cream text and tomato red highlights. Combines the structure of Swiss brutalism with the playful and high-end editorial vibe of a modern creative agency.

typography.rules: NO em dashes anywhere. Use commas or colons. Headings must have tight letter spacing. Body text should be clean and readable.

layout_sections.details: Sticky header with glassmorphism over dark background. Left: Logo 'Brandmefy' (Capital B). Right: Links and Contact CTA. Must have smooth scroll to sections.

Massive typography. Heading: 'Your brand deserves to be Seen, Heard, and Remembered'. Underneath, an infinite marquee showing words like 'Creative', 'Timeless', 'Edgy' in large outline text. Use hero_bg image as a subtle 20% opacity background texture.

3 cards in a row. 1: 'Fast and Reliable Delivery' with value_prop rocket image. 2: 'Clear, No-Surprise Pricing' with value_prop price image. 3: 'Everything, Under One Roof' with value_prop roof image. Minimalist dark cards.
Text 'We built the rocket, they flew' above a continuous marquee of text logos: LunarLab, VibeCraft, Sunbeam, NeonVibe, HorizonHue.
4 huge numbers counting up. Brands launched (120+), Projects Delivered (350+), Moodboards created (500+), Happy clients (99%).

Title: 'What we do (and do really well)'. Left column: Accordion or hover-list of 4 services (Branding & Identity, Web Design and Development, Content Creation, Digital Marketing). Right column: Image carousel/fade matching the hovered service. Use services_fallback image.

Title: 'Why we are the best!'. 7 cards. 1: Creative Sparks. 2: Design That Delivers. 3: Adaptable & Flexible. 4: Human-Centered Approach. 5: Global Vision, Local Focus. 6: Ideas You Didn't See Coming. 7: Every Detail Matters. Use Lucide icons + subtle background shapes from benefit_shapes.
Title: 'Look what we made!'. 4 large cards displaying the 4 portfolio images (Bold Brew, FlexFit, SpeedShip, Bloomberry). Overlay text on hover 'View Case Study'.
Title: 'Our not-so secret sauce'. 4 steps. 1: Kickoff & Coffee Chats. 2: Strategy & Concepts. 3: Design & Refine. 4: Launch & Celebrate.

Two columns. Left: 'Other Agencies' (faded gray text: Generic Solutions, Hidden Costs, Boring Creativity). Right: 'Brandmefy' (bright cream text with Tomato Red checkmarks: Personalized Plans, Transparent Pricing, Bold Ideas).
Title: 'Clients talk & we blush'. Mix of text testimonial cards and video thumbnail cards (use video_testimonial_thumb).

Big bold text block: 'We started at a kitchen table with coffee, chaos, and a shared love for bold ideas. Now we are a small team doing big things... No fluff, no fuss, just fun, friendly, scroll-stopping creativity.'
3 team member cards using the team images, plus 1 card saying 'Maybe You / Cause we are hiring' with a link to apply.
Title: 'You ask, we answer.'. Standard 5-6 question accordion about timeline, revisions, etc.

REPLACES PRICING SECTION. Title: 'Speak to Us'. Subtitle: 'Let us build something great together. No hidden fees, just honest work.'. Form fields: Name, Email, Company, Message. Submit button triggers POST to /api/contact which sends Resend email to brandmefymedia@gmail.com.
Massive Brandmefy logo. Grid of nav links. Social icons. Copyright 2026.

motion_rules.scroll_reveal: All major sections should fade in and slide up slightly on scroll using framer-motion.
motion_rules.hover_effects: Cards should slightly lift (-translate-y-1) and increase border brightness on hover.
motion_rules.button_interactions: CTAs should have scale effect on tap.

testing: Ensure EVERY interactive element has a data-testid attribute.

backend_integration.action: Send email via Resend to brandmefymedia@gmail.com
